# Wiped 1.1.9
## Mac installer
- Updates Apple Account sign-in for verification codes from a trusted Apple device. Ryan verified this path in private build23; build24 packages the same authentication code under the new release identity. - Keeps machine-verification recovery bounded and preserves existing account, pairing and settings storage. - SMS-only Apple Accounts remain unsupported by this fix; SMS sign-in is still being investigated. Use a trusted-device code when your account offers it. - Universal installer for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
## iPhone app and Live Activity
- Version metadata advances to 1.1.9/build24 so the installed phone app matches the advertised release. Phone authentication behavior and features remain unchanged from build22; the Mac-specific sign-in code is not included in the phone SDK.
Updating the Mac installer does not replace the app already installed on an iPhone. Use Install options → Reinstall Wiped with Fresh install unchecked to replace it while retaining the existing settings-recovery path. Production phone-only updating remains disabled. Windows release packaging is separate.
